page.notes: Catchword "l. Seri" at lower right; the "l." may be a signature mark, uncertain. "frote" is doubtful (possibly "fronte" with a suspension mark). "p̄" after "qua" is doubtful. The letter passages are set in italic, the commentary in roman. The ampersand is printed as a special sign, transcribed as &. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept only where visible ("are-facti", "infu-matæq;", "nobi-le", "pa-lato", "ha-bere", "in-terdum"). The "lau dat." break shows no hyphen and is written "laudat".
